name: MeowFactory
description:
About This Game

Welcome to the MEOWFACTORY!

In the near and depressing future, when the world is on the verge of destruction, ONLY THEY can revive production!

Yes, yes, ONLY MEOWORKERS!

Build magnificent factories to meet the needs of laazy hoomans!

And don’t forget — when your meoworkers only have paws, hammies are tough to handle.

Automate production lines and manage limited space to achieve perfection. Connect machines with conveyor lines and minimize hand (well, paw) labour!

Oh, also keep an eye on your fluffy conveyor belt riders and pull them away before they stick their curious noses into machines!

Build a full production cycle to maximize product variety for your customers!

And make sure your fluffy employees don't gobble up everything along the way!

Gather a team of professionals! Look after their mood, cleanliness, and find the right place for each of them!

Otherwise, these cats will blow up, puke on, or burn down everything you've built, or at the very least turn your nice and tidy factory into a branch of cat hell.

And break the record for the number of days without accidents!
It will be EXTREMELY DIFFICULT.

All this awaits you at the MEOWFACTORY!
